title: デビュー戦の後に・ビッグな新人

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And coming through with flying colors in her debut race is—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wow! Bono was sooo cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I couldn't take my eyes off her! I've never seen someone so big run so fast!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: No kidding! She has presence and power in spades! I can't wait to see what's next in store for her!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wow… There are so many smiling faces everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: Welcome back. Good work out there!
Welcome back. Good work out there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Everyone from the stands was smiling at me after the race. It felt so nice…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I want to make even more people smile! I want to make it so the audience feels as warm as if they just finished playing tag!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And for that, there's only one thing I have to do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I need to get so buono at racing that everyone smiles when they watch me…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And make it so the stands fill up with more and more people!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Now that that's settled, I'm gonna whip up lots of food! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her exclamation comes off as a non sequitur to me, but I'm sure Hishi Akebono has a reason for making such a declaration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whatever the case, if she wants to electrify the stadium, then we're going to need to draw in more fans first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now it's just a matter of keeping up with training and figuring out how to get her name out at the same time!
